title: Protected budget reservations
description: Objective: add atomic executor admission reservations on the conserved ledger from task-a5def097bcb7495e935204bd845160b4. Deliverable: packages/scheduler/src/budget/budget-reservation.ts, its one-line .js bridge, and focused tests for reserve-or-refuse, one-use activation, and proven-never-started cancellation across caller-supplied EXECUTION, VERIFICATION, INDEPENDENT_REVIEW, FINAL_ACCEPTANCE, and CONTINGENCY amounts. NOT in scope: choosing reserve amounts, policy evaluation or approval validation, provider quotes, measurements, settlement/quarantine, fan-out materialization/integration, persistence, or package-root export. Hard dependencies: task-7dc2e4870d7d4096a1be7b5991e50e94 and task-a5def097bcb7495e935204bd845160b4 must be DONE unchanged. Owned paths: budget-reservation.ts, budget-reservation.js, budget-reservation.test.ts. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/scheduler typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/scheduler exec vitest run --root ../.. packages/scheduler/src/budget/budget-reservation.test.ts.
definitionOfDone: Admission atomically reserves the complete caller-supplied execution, verification, independent-review, final-acceptance, and contingency set or returns a frozen refusal with no state or ledger-entry change.
The exact available boundary succeeds, one unit short refuses, and no operation can spend or reclassify a protected purpose through an EXECUTION reservation.

A reservation activates at most once; stale-version activate/cancel competitors yield one legal winner and a zero-effect loser, while cancellation refunds only a proven-never-started refundable reservation.

Malformed/duplicate purpose entries, zero or unsafe quantities, missing protected purposes, closed/overdrawn accounts, and policy outcomes other than an already-validated allowance or current human approval fail closed in deterministic precedence.
Both TypeScript files are <=250 physical lines, the bridge is one exact re-export line, and the focused verification command exits 0.
taskRails: Reserve minima are caller-supplied immutable facts; do not guess token, currency, verification, review, acceptance, or contingency amounts.
Consume only a narrow already-validated policy/approval gate structurally aligned with the committed core interface; do not forge approvals, duplicate evaluatePolicy, or import @moe/core.
Production and test TypeScript files must each be <=250 physical lines; stage only the three explicit owned paths.

Cases: (1) ALL-OR-NONE ADMISSION: reserveForAdmission over a caller-supplied five-purpose amount set against a ledger-derived available view — success returns a frozen ReservationRecord (per-purpose lines, deterministic reservationId from accountId+admissionRef, state RESERVED, version) + the updated frozen bucket view; planningNotes.approachesConsidered: Direct plan (fifth budget/scheduler sibling; conventions locked; governor card written at full fidelity against landed surfaces). Design choices: (1) ADMISSION_PURPOSES as a module-local five-tuple (EXECUTION + four protected) with an explicit mapping comment onto the landed contract RESERVE_PURPOSES (INDEPENDENT_REVIEW->REVIEW, FINAL_ACCEPTANCE->ACCEPTANCE_PROCESSING) — the task text and the landed vocabulary use different spellings; inventing new contract entries or editing budget-contract.ts (unowned) are both wrong, and EXECUTION is the admitted work, not a contract reserve purpose (design 587). (2) Pure caller-supplied-state functions, no registries (sibling precedent — determinism + repeat-call deep-equal). (3) Three-layer issue codes (contract BUDGET_*, account BUDGET_ACCOUNT_*, new BUDGET_RESERVATION_*) so the assert-which-layer rail is satisfiable. (4) Gate as narrow structural mirror of the committed core shapes ({decisionRef, outcome:'ALLOW'} / {approvalRef, decision:'APPROVE', validity:'CURRENT'}) — already-validated facts only, no evaluatePolicy duplication, no @moe/core import (task rail). (5) Activation is a one-use MARKER binding attemptRef — bucket movement to COMMITTED belongs to settlement (17.04/17.05); cancel refunds RESERVED->AVAILABLE only with a never-started proof ref (design 12.2 pre-active tombstone analogue).

planningNotes.risks: (1) Partial-set laundering is THE conservation hazard — all-or-none mutation red-check mandatory. (2) Purpose reclassification through the EXECUTION line would let execution spend consume proof reserves (design 587's exact prohibition) — fence + red-check. (3) Double-activation under version races — exactly-one-winner asserted (aliasing gotcha precedent). (4) Vocabulary spelling drift between the task card and the landed contract — the local mapping comment is the honest resolution; editing unowned files is not. (5) Gate forgery — structural mirror validated hostile; wrong-outcome/stale-validity distinct codes. (6) 250-pressure on the test (seven families): tighten fixtures, never drop assertions. (7) Shared tree: 17.04 WORKING — three-path commit, by-path attribution.
